units: Par. II, 2; Bekh. 44ᵃ יָגוֹד let him lop off (the black tops of the horns or hoofs).—[V. גָּדַר.]—Trnsf. (cmp. קצץ) to fix the price.
B. Bath. 13ᵃ גּוֹד או אָגוֹד either fix you a price for my share, or I shall do so (and buy your share); דינא דגוד או אגוד the right of settling by god o agod.

Ib. אגוד איכא גוד ליכא the offer to buy is applicable in this case (the half-freed slave can offer to buy his other half), but the offer to sell cannot be made (since there is no price for a free man).—Part. pass. גָּדוּד stripped (of branches); trnsf. empty-handed.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 68">Gen. R. s. 68</cite>, beg. <he>ג׳ שלחו</he> (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 117">Yalk. ib. 117</cite> <cite ref="C00175"><he>גדודי</he></cite>) Isaac sent Jacob away without anything valuable.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 71:9">Gen. R. s. 71</cite> (play on <he>בא גד</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 30:11">Gen. XXX, 11</cite>) <he>בא מי שעתיד לגַדֵּד וכ׳</he> he has come who is destined to level the fastnesses of the nations (idolatry). Tanḥ. Ki Thissa 13 (play on <he>מגדל גד</he>, <cite ref="Joshua 15:37">Josh. XV, 37</cite>) from there the Lord <he>יוצא ומְגַדֵּד וכ׳</he> will proceed and level &c.; <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 40:4">Ex. R. s. 40</cite> <he>ומגיד</he> (corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Ketubot 51a:1">Keth. 51ᵃ</cite> <he>כל העומד לִיגָּדֵד כְּגָדוּד דמי</he> Ar. (ed. <he>ליגזז</he>, v. <cite ref="C00537"><he>גָּזַז</he></cite>).

senses.gloss: to make incisions in one’s own body.
units: <cite ref="Yevamot 13b">Yeb. 13ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="C00300"><he>גּוּד</he></cite>. Tanḥ. Sh’laḥ. 15; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 17">Num. R. s. 17</cite> <he>קבר מת לא תִתְגּוֹדְדוּ</he> when one buried a dead, the law says, Ye shall not &c. (<cite ref="Deuteronomy 14:1">Deut. XIV, 1</cite>). V. <cite ref="C00198"><he>גְּדִידָה</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: same. Yeb. l. c. א״כ לימא קרא לא תְּגוֹדְדוּ if it were so (that Deut. XIV, 1 meant only to forbid incisions in the body) it ought to read lo t’god’du, ye shall make no incisions.
